## 배틀워크스
### 0.1.7 Change Log
#### Global
##### Added
* Added searchable NPC templates with appearance previews.
* Added Undo and Redo for document edits and file loading.
* Added ground attack warnings linked to hitboxes with progress indicators.
* Added arena boundaries that return escaping bosses and optionally restore their health.
* Added DNPC template summons with groups, lifetimes, editable stats, and restart persistence.
* Added a BattleWorks Wand for opening editors and settings.
* Added simple pattern editing and ready-to-edit attack recipes.
* Added a personal technique library and independent copies of attacks and linked combat resources.
##### Fixed
* Fixed custom humanoid animation selection and playback.
* Fixed combat cleanup interrupting movement controlled by other mods.
##### Changed
* Changed DRM to an optional integration while preserving saved combat settings.
* Changed BattleWorks tools to appear in both standalone and available DNPC Creative Tabs.
##### Improved
* Improved editor layout, input alignment, search, scrolling, Korean labels, and seconds/ticks displays.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed DNPC and standalone NPC previews failing when CustomNPCs was absent.
#### Fabric & NeoForge 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed missing BattleWorks keybinding category names.
